text: {"780":{"about":["rustc_middle"],"refers":[],"why":"It explains MIR scope metadata and the basic-block structure defined by rustc_middle's MIR representation."},"781":{"about":["rustc_middle"],"refers":[],"why":"StorageLive and StorageDead are MIR statement variants whose liveness meaning is part of the MIR definition."},"782":{"about":["rustc_middle","rustc_codegen_llvm"],"refers":[],"why":"The storage statements are MIR constructs defined in rustc_middle and consumed by the LLVM backend for stack-storage handling."},"783":{"about":["rustc_middle"],"refers":[],"why":"It describes MIR terminators and their control-flow successors, which are properties of the MIR data structures."},"784":{"about":["rustc_middle","rustc_mir_build"],"refers":[],"why":"The MIR call terminator models both normal and unwind control-flow edges, and MIR construction emits calls in that form."}}
